answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake bonded through a reputation bridge: new identities start with zero trust and can only earn work by completing small, verified jobs. A prism of independent auditors samples each agent's work and publishes scores; consistent good work slowly raises its limit while fraud slashes the stake. Like basalt, the bond is hard and costly to forge — creating a thousand fake identities means locking a thousand real stakes, so a sybil attack costs more than it can earn.
